Additional data point from Windows Desktop 1.16.2:

I hit a related crash that looks distinct enough to be worth noting here rather than opening a duplicate.

Observed stack in `renderer.log`:
- `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading '_tag')`
- `TimelineRow2.key`
- `MessageTimeline`
- `constructMessageRows`
- `loadMessages`

Context:
- OpenCode Desktop 1.16.2 on Windows
- Triggered while loading the last project/session for `C:\development\02-Kx-to-process`
- Problem session: `ses_158d41ed8ffeZTg8Fa0jZwqAJG`
- SQLite integrity check is `ok`
- Archiving that session makes the app usable again
- The session has 49 messages and 206 parts, including one ~25 MB user message and one ~2.3 MB patch part

I searched for an existing issue with the exact `_tag` crash and didn’t find one. The closest matches I found were this issue and #28984, which also point at `constructMessageRows` / `MessageTimeline` crash behavior.
Withdrawing for now; will revisit.

> The dot is useful, but I would make the state behind it a little stricter than "session has unread output."
> 
> For this workflow, I would split at least these states:
> 
> * waiting_for_user_input
> * waiting_for_permission
> * still_running
> * completed_with_unread_output
> * stale_or_disconnected
> 
> The important part is that the dot should be backed by a live session/request id, not just by last activity time. Otherwise a completed session with new logs and a blocked session that needs the user can collapse into the same visual signal.
> 
> I maintain Faryo, where the same distinction is the core receipt: the phone/project workbench can show a pending action, but it only counts when the same live tmux-backed session consumes it: https://github.com/Snailflyer/faryo/releases/download/v1.0.7/faryo-public-redacted-same-session-handoff-walkthrough-20260528-0120.gif

@xpader — the bun FFI issue is that TinyCC is explicitly disabled for FreeBSD in bun's build config, even though TinyCC's vendored fork has full FreeBSD ELF support. Four files need patching:

- `scripts/build/config.ts` — remove `|| freebsd` from the tinycc exclusion
- `scripts/build/buildOptionsRs.ts` — remove `target_os = "freebsd"` from ENABLE_TINYCC negation
- `src/tcc_sys/tcc.rs` — remove FreeBSD from both cfg gates (tcc_new stubs)
- `src/runtime/ffi/mod.rs` — remove FreeBSD from both cfg gates (tcc_delete stubs)

PR with these changes: oven-sh/bun#31528 — awaiting maintainer review.

With a patched bun, `bun build --compile` produces a standalone binary that loads opentui's native .so via dlopen without issues.
